updates.title: Build paths checked for every specialization
updates.summary: Added one source-backed, loadable talent path for each of the 70 specializations. We cross-checked Sidekick paths against current trees, used updated embedded guide paths or a community archive build where Sidekick’s July snapshot no longer matched, and left Sidekick stat and tier claims out.

updates.title: More CoA research is searchable
updates.summary: Added 239 Vaults of the Inquisition SQL creature-loot candidate rows across 16 NPCs to the Research Explorer. They are source-derived candidates, not verified live drops. The latest v2.0.1 release also documents the trainer-rank audit and open evidence gaps.

updates.title: Addons and WeakAuras refreshed
updates.summary: Added NecroMinions-CoA and refreshed WeakAuras-CoA to v1.0.7. The community WeakAura pack index still reflects its latest available Aug 8 snapshot.

updates.title: Build archive coverage made explicit
updates.summary: The verified community archive now offers 63 of 128 captured builds across 36 specializations. Unmapped or rule-invalid records stay out of the calculator until their allocations are reconciled.

updates.title: Gear stat priorities clarified
updates.summary: Weapon and ranged DPS factors are separated from actual gear stats and explained as damage-source context on each specialization page.

updates.title: Community builds added
updates.summary: The talent builder includes 63 community builds that pass current tree and calculator rules across 36 specializations. Archived votes and views indicate community activity, not combat rankings.

updates.title: Icon reliability
updates.summary: Class and talent icons now retry from a second source and retain a visible fallback when an image is unavailable.
